own.name: Franchise Group
own.q: The Company also intends to amend its August 21, 2023 Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC in connection with the closing of its investment in Franchise Group, Inc. (“FRG”), which amended Form 8-K will include the filing of FRG’s statements of operations for the year and six months ended December 31, 2022 and June 30, 2023, respectively, and balance sheet as of June 30, 2023, as well as related Company pro forma financials.
